name: @w6w-apps/twist
description: Twist messaging for threads, comments and conversations, with poll triggers for new messages, channels, comments, conversations, groups, threads, workspaces and workspace users.

w6w.longDescription:
Twist is Doist's async team messaging tool: conversations live in threads inside channels, so a message is a post that can be answered whenever people get to it. This app puts that structure in a workflow.

It covers the working loop of a team that uses Twist: post a thread to a channel, comment on it, close or reopen it, pin or star it, and move it between channels; send direct messages in a conversation; add reactions; and read the inbox, unread threads and search results to decide what needs a reply.

Beyond messaging, the app manages the structure around it — workspaces, channels, groups, and workspace members — plus notification settings, join links, loop-in email addresses and event webhooks, so a workflow can react to Twist events instead of polling for them. Sign in with OAuth for a shared connection, or paste a personal test token for development.

Twist's file-upload endpoint takes multipart bytes and is not offered, and the user-account endpoints that handle passwords or rotate the API token are deliberately left out, so a workflow can never change or expose the login behind a connection. Poll trigger: new messages in a conversation.
